role_label: Reference proteome & identical-sequence protein-equivalence groups (PEG)
label: Human Ensembl 115 GRCh38 + MANE Select
threshold_or_use: Prefer MANE Select then Ensembl canonical; collapse identical translations into PEG; >=95% 9-mer Unsafe containment -> Other:Sequence
limitations: Representative-protein equivalence does not assert equal abundance of alternative isoforms.

role_label: Healthy non-thymic, non-reproductive baseline (N) & Disposable maximum (D)
label: GTEx v11, HPA v23 tissues/brain & HPA/DICE/Monaco immune
threshold_or_use: Within-site linear donor P95 sets non-thymic somatic N and Disposable D (<=32 TPM); H0 = max(N, D, 1 TPM)
limitations: 56 required healthy contexts; bulk thymus stays in thymic scope outside N and D.

role_label: Normal somatic bulk & sorted immune RNA safety ceilings
label: HPA v23 consensus/brain/immune, GTEx v11 medians & DICE/Monaco
threshold_or_use: Base ceilings Vital <=4, Protected <=8, Manageable <=16 (Unsafe >128) in native unit; matched negative IHC raises ceiling 2x/4x/8x
limitations: TPM and nTPM run separate native gates without cross-unit conversion.

role_label: Single-cell cluster & donor-resolved rare-cell UMI safety screens
label: CELLxGENE Census, Siletti brain, HPA v23 scRNA clusters & Collin cornea
threshold_or_use: UMI: >=10 cells and >=1% >=2-UMI cells across >=2 consortium-deduplicated study groups (or >=5% in 1 study; 2x in Protected); cornea CP10K /100 nominal ceiling
limitations: Paralog/3'-host mapping ambiguity without bulk or qPCR confirmation stays Other:Review.

role_label: Normal-tissue protein staining (IHC) or mass-spectrometry proteomics
label: HPA v23 normal immunohistochemistry & curated external staining
threshold_or_use: Approved/Supported/Enhanced positive staining in Vital/Protected tissues -> Unsafe; routine-context negative IHC grants RNA headroom
limitations: Antibody reliability is categorical support, not a calibrated false-negative rate.

role_label: Adult reproductive & embryonic/placental enrichment (RA) and host exposure
label: GTEx/HPA adult reproductive samples & Petropoulos/Tyser/Molè embryos
threshold_or_use: RA qualifies at >=10 x H0 in adult reproductive samples or cell-supported embryo lineages; per-compartment maxima feed HostContext (<4 TPM / <4 nTPM)
limitations: Early embryo atlases do not cover mid/late fetal stages; pregnancy protection remains conservative.

role_label: QC-passing tumor cohorts for cancer enrichment (CA)
label: 132 QC-passing per-sample human tumor cohorts (TCGA, TARGET, BEAT-AML, Treehouse, GEO)
threshold_or_use: CA qualifies when >=1 QC-passing library reaches >=10 x H0; known-patient counts deduplicate samples per donor
limitations: Cross-study cohorts use library QC and nonnegative linear TPM checks rather than batch correction.

role_label: Curated normal counterevidence, unscreened adult homes & published nominations
label: Reviewed normal-tissue literature, #711 Ensembl 115 attribution ledger & 149 CTA/oncofetal papers
threshold_or_use: Verified adult Vital/Protected expression -> Unsafe; unscreened adult home (olfactory, taste bud, bone, dental pulp, hair follicle) -> Other:Unscreened tissue
limitations: Published CTA nominations are provenance only and never override normal-tissue counterevidence.

role_label: Reference proteome & identical-sequence protein-equivalence groups (PEG)
label: Canine NCBI RefSeq 106 (UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0) & Ensembl 98 (CanFam3.1)
threshold_or_use: Complete GTF/FASTA/feature_table pins; identical translations collapse into canine PEG:<sha256>; >=95% canine 9-mer Unsafe containment
limitations: RefSeq 106 and CanFam3.1 Ensembl 98 are distinct assemblies requiring an explicit ReferenceCrosswalk.

role_label: Healthy non-thymic, non-reproductive baseline (N) & Disposable maximum (D)
label: Bgee 15.2 canine normal RNA-seq (13 + 75 libraries, TPM) & BarkBase (150 libraries, TMM-CPM)
threshold_or_use: Within-organ donor P95 sets somatic N and canine Disposable D (gallbladder, tonsil, hair follicle, cutaneous melanocyte; no appendix); never pool TPM with TMM-CPM
limitations: Exact source quantification GTFs are unresolved, and BarkBase shares 46 SRA runs with global Bgee.

role_label: Normal somatic bulk & sorted immune RNA safety ceilings
label: Bgee TPM, BarkBase TMM-CPM & DoGA / Pfizer canine RNA metadata
threshold_or_use: Tiered somatic ceilings Vital <=4, Protected <=8, Manageable <=16 (Unsafe >128) in declared panel unit without negative-IHC inflation
limitations: DoGA (5'-end ERCC) and Pfizer Ensembl-110 Salmon RNA are currently metadata-only.

role_label: Single-cell cluster & donor-resolved rare-cell UMI safety screens
label: Donor-resolved canine normal single-cell UMI atlases
threshold_or_use: Same assess_rare_cell_rna contract (>=10 cells, >=1% >=2-UMI across >=2 canine studies, 2x in Protected) when single-cell atlases are ingested
limitations: No multi-organ adult canine normal single-cell UMI atlas is currently bundled; rare-cell status stays unassessed.

role_label: Normal-tissue protein staining (IHC) or mass-spectrometry proteomics
label: Pfizer 38-tissue canine quantitative proteomics (MSV000099744, 9,929 groups)
threshold_or_use: Affirmative Vital/Protected tissue-pool protein detection supplies Unsafe/hold review once searched-FASTA groups reconcile to canine genes; never grants negative-IHC RNA credit
limitations: All 38 tissue samples are pooled TMT channels without individual-donor counts or cell-type resolution.

role_label: Adult reproductive & embryonic/placental enrichment (RA) and host exposure
label: Bgee & BarkBase canine testis, ovary, oviduct, uterine horn, prostate, mammary & embryonic libraries
threshold_or_use: RA qualifies at >=10 x H0 across canine compartments (includes uterine_horn; omits absent seminal vesicle and bulbourethral gland); feeds canine HostContext
limitations: BarkBase embryonic donor IDs and column-to-run provenance remain unresolved.

role_label: QC-passing tumor cohorts for cancer enrichment (CA)
label: GSE304066 canine osteosarcoma & published canine tumor RT-qPCR/RNA observations
threshold_or_use: CA requires >=1 QC-passing tumor library at >=10 x H0 on the same reconciled reference and linear unit as the canine normal panel
limitations: GSE304066 raw-count filename conflicts with FPKM metadata; Hindriks 2025 and Nemec 2019 lack genome-wide linear TPM.

role_label: Curated normal counterevidence, unscreened adult homes & published nominations
label: Curated canine CTA nominations and normal/tumor study observations (14 candidates)
threshold_or_use: Retains native canine gene mappings, paralog assay ambiguity, and positive normal somatic observations; packaged rows remain Other:Review until panels reconcile
limitations: Human CTA labels are never transferred to canine orthologs.

role_label: Reference proteome & identical-sequence protein-equivalence groups (PEG)
label: Mouse Ensembl 115 GRCm39 (GCA_000001635.9, C57BL/6J, 66,668 proteins)
threshold_or_use: Complete GTF/cDNA/ncRNA/peptide FASTA pins; identical translations collapse into murine PEG:<sha256>; >=95% murine 9-mer Unsafe containment
limitations: Reference coordinates are C57BL/6J; historical DBA/2 and BALB/c Polymorphisms require explicit sequence verification.

role_label: Healthy non-thymic, non-reproductive baseline (N) & Disposable maximum (D)
label: Mouse adult normal multi-organ bulk RNA-seq (Bgee / ENCODE GRCm39 analogs)
threshold_or_use: Within-organ donor P95 sets somatic N and murine Disposable D (gallbladder, hair follicle, cutaneous melanocyte; mouse lacks appendix and palatine tonsil)
limitations: Not yet ingested into the wheel; strain, sex and age must remain explicit per library.

role_label: Normal somatic bulk & sorted immune RNA safety ceilings
label: Sarma 1999 BALB/c somatic RT-PCR/Southern seed & murine bulk/ImmGen immune analogs
threshold_or_use: Quantitative panels apply Vital <=4, Protected <=8, Manageable <=16 (Unsafe >128) TPM; qualitative somatic RT-PCR counterevidence blocks admission
limitations: Sarma 1999 covers 5 BALB/c organs without absolute TPM or reported animal counts.

role_label: Single-cell cluster & donor-resolved rare-cell UMI safety screens
label: Tabula Muris / Tabula Muris Senis (10x droplet UMI & FACS Smart-seq2)
threshold_or_use: 10x droplet UMI enters assess_rare_cell_rna (>=10 cells, >=1% >=2-UMI across >=2 studies, 2x in Protected) with mouse study/animal provenance
limitations: Identified in cta-selection-sources.csv; raw H5AD ingestion and Ensembl 115 reconciliation pending.

role_label: Normal-tissue protein staining (IHC) or mass-spectrometry proteomics
label: MGI Gene Expression Database (GXD) adult normal protein/IHC assays
threshold_or_use: Verified Vital/Protected adult normal protein detection -> Unsafe; unanalyzed tissues never count as negative-IHC credit
limitations: Literature-identified; requires distinguishing measured not-detected from unassayed organs.

role_label: Adult reproductive & embryonic/placental enrichment (RA) and host exposure
label: MOCA (E9.5-E13.5 UMI), Mouse Gastrulation scRNA, GXD & adult reproductive panels
threshold_or_use: RA qualifies at >=10 x H0 across murine compartments (includes coagulating_gland, seminal vesicle, uterine_horn); UMI atlases retain separate unit contracts
limitations: UMI counts in MOCA cannot use nominal TPM cutoffs without a reconciled TPM developmental panel.

role_label: QC-passing tumor cohorts for cancer enrichment (CA)
label: J558 plasmacytoma seed & syngeneic/GEMM mouse tumor RNA-seq (P815, B16-F10, MC38, CT26, 4T1)
threshold_or_use: CA requires >=1 QC-passing murine tumor sample at >=10 x H0 on Ensembl 115 TPM; cell lines vs primary GEMM/syngeneic grafts tracked explicitly
limitations: Strain match between tumor host (e.g. DBA/2 P815, BALB/c CT26, C57BL/6 MC38/B16) and normal reference must be recorded.

role_label: Curated normal counterevidence, unscreened adult homes & published nominations
label: Van den Eynde 1991 (P1A DBA/2 P815 clone 211) & Sarma 1999 endogenous normal-tissue follow-up
threshold_or_use: Preserves exact 224-aa AAA40475.1 / ENSMUSP00000059448.4 protein equivalence alongside BALB/c lung/spleen/liver/thymus counterevidence -> Other:Review
limitations: Transgenic tolerance experiments are excluded from endogenous normal-expression claims.
